title: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE Navigator (NCCN Guidelines Version 1.2026)
provenanceNote: Comprehensive NCCN Guidelines Version 1.2026 clinical navigator for Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia. Covers complete clinical algorithm: Diagnostic Workup (bone marrow aspirate and biopsy with morphology, MPO staining and flow immunophenotyping, rapid PML::RARA testing to rule out APL, karyotype plus FISH plus NGS for CBF fusions, NPM1, CEBPA bZIP, FLT3, KMT2A and high-risk cytogenetics, diagnostic lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and concurrent IT cytarabine, baseline echocardiogram before anthracyclines, early HLA typing of patient, parents and siblings) -> Subtype and Risk Stratification (APL vs Low-Risk CBF vs Intermediate-Risk vs High-Risk vs Relapsed/Refractory) -> APL chemotherapy-free ATRA plus ATO per COG AAML1331 -> Low-Risk ADE plus gemtuzumab ozogamicin then HD-cytarabine consolidation without HCT in CR1 -> Intermediate-Risk ADE plus GO with flow MRD-guided consolidation versus matched sibling HCT -> High-Risk intensive induction plus FLT3 TKI with mandatory allogeneic HCT in CR1 -> Relapsed/Refractory FLAG-Ida or CPX-351 or targeted salvage (gilteritinib, revumenib) bridging to second HCT or CAR T-cell trials. References StewardMD Standard Protocols. DRAFT - clinical decision support; physician decides and dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
sourceNote: Structured in accordance with NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines) for Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia Version 1.2026.

a.text: Suspected APL is a medical emergency: send rapid PML::RARA FISH/RT-PCR at presentation and start ATRA immediately when APL is suspected while awaiting confirmation, with aggressive coagulopathy support (cryoprecipitate to keep fibrinogen above 150 mg/dL, platelets above 50,000/uL).

b.text: Core-binding factor AML [t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) RUNX1::RUNX1T1, inv(16)(p13.1q22) CBFB::MYH11], NPM1-mutant without FLT3-ITD high allelic ratio, and biallelic/bZIP CEBPA-mutant disease define low-risk pediatric AML treated with chemotherapy alone in CR1 (overall survival above 75-80%).

c.text: Flow-cytometric minimal residual disease (MRD) threshold 0.1% (1 leukemic cell per 1,000 nucleated cells) after 2 induction cycles guides intermediate-risk disposition: MRD negative below 0.1% proceeds to HD-cytarabine consolidation with or without matched sibling donor HCT; persistent MRD 0.1% or higher allocates to allogeneic HCT from the best available donor.

d.text: FLT3-mutated AML: FLT3-ITD high allelic ratio defines high-risk disease requiring TKI integration (sorafenib 200 mg/m2/day or midostaurin per protocol) plus mandatory allogeneic HCT in CR1; FLT3-ITD low allelic ratio without other high-risk features is managed on the intermediate-risk MRD-guided pathway.

e.text: Gemtuzumab ozogamicin (GO) 3 mg/m2 on day 6 of ADE induction (fractionated CD33-directed calicheamicin conjugate) improves event-free survival in CD33-positive CBF and intermediate-risk AML; monitor for sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (veno-occlusive disease), myelosuppression, and hepatotoxicity.

f.text: Relapsed or refractory AML: confirm FLT3 status (gilteritinib for FLT3-mutated relapse) and KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation (revumenib menin inhibitor) at relapse, restage marrow and CNS, and bridge second remission to allogeneic HCT or CAR T-cell clinical trials wherever available.

nodes.name: Diagnostic Workup
nodes.title: Pediatric AML: Diagnostic Workup Checklist
nodes.description: Step 1: Complete the clinical workup before subtype and risk stratification. Confirm myeloid lineage by morphology and flow, immediately rule out APL with rapid PML::RARA testing, complete cytogenetic and molecular profiling, establish CNS status with concurrent intrathecal therapy, document cardiac function before anthracyclines, and HLA type the family early for transplant planning.
bullets: Diagnostic bone marrow aspirate and biopsy: morphology, myeloperoxidase (MPO) staining, and comprehensive flow cytometric immunophenotyping (CD33, CD34, CD117, CD13, CD14, HLA-DR)
Rapid PML::RARA testing (FISH / RT-PCR) to immediately identify or rule out Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL)

Comprehensive cytogenetics and molecular testing: Karyotype, FISH, and NGS panel for CBF fusions [t(8;21), inv(16)], NPM1, CEBPA bZIP, FLT3 (ITD and TKD), KMT2A (11q23) rearrangements, monosomy 7/5q, inv(3)
Diagnostic lumbar puncture with CSF cytology for CNS involvement (CNS-1, CNS-2, CNS-3) with concurrent prophylactic intrathecal chemotherapy (IT Cytarabine)
Baseline echocardiogram for left ventricular function prior to anthracycline exposure
Early HLA typing of patient, biological parents, and full siblings for potential allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT)

nodes.name: Subtype and Risk Stratification
nodes.title: Pediatric AML: Subtype and Risk Stratification
nodes.description: Workup complete. Assign APL status, cytogenetic and molecular risk group, FLT3 allelic ratio, and remission/MRD response; the group selects the APL, low-risk, intermediate-risk, high-risk, or relapsed/refractory pathway.
nodes.path: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia / Subtype and Risk Stratification
bullets: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL): t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA confirmed by FISH or RT-PCR; medical emergency managed with chemotherapy-free differentiating therapy.
Low-Risk / Core-Binding Factor AML: t(8;21), inv(16), NPM1-mutant without FLT3-ITD high allelic ratio, or CEBPA bZIP; chemotherapy alone in CR1 with overall survival above 75-80%.
Intermediate-Risk AML: normal cytogenetics, KMT2A-rearranged disease, or FLT3-ITD low allelic ratio; disposition guided by flow-cytometric MRD after 2 induction cycles.
High-Risk AML: monosomy 7, del(5q), inv(3), t(6;9), FLT3-ITD high allelic ratio, or induction failure; mandatory allogeneic HCT in CR1.
Relapsed or Refractory AML: primary induction failure or any relapse after frontline therapy; FLT3, KMT2A and NPM1 status determine targeted salvage before second HCT.

nodes.name: APL Treatment
nodes.title: APL: Chemotherapy-Free ATRA Plus Arsenic Trioxide (COG AAML1331)
nodes.description: Chemotherapy-free differentiating therapy for PML::RARA-positive APL with differentiation syndrome prophylaxis and aggressive coagulopathy support; cure rate above 95%.
nodes.path: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia / APL / Treatment
bullets: Chemotherapy-free differentiating therapy per COG AAML1331: ATRA (all-trans retinoic acid 25 mg/m2/day PO divided BID) plus Arsenic Trioxide (ATO 0.15 mg/kg/day IV daily) until remission, then consolidation per protocol.

Prophylactic dexamethasone for differentiation syndrome (fever, weight gain, respiratory distress, effusions); hold differentiating agents and escalate steroids at first signs of moderate or severe syndrome.
Aggressive coagulopathy support from presentation: cryoprecipitate to keep fibrinogen above 150 mg/dL, platelets above 50,000/uL; avoid leukapheresis and monitor for hemorrhage and thrombosis.
Baseline and serial ECG for QTc prolongation on ATO with electrolyte repletion (potassium, magnesium), plus hepatic and neurologic monitoring; cure rate above 95% with this approach.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: ATRA + Arsenic Trioxide (ATO) Chemotherapy-Free Standard (COG AAML1331)

nodes.name: Low-Risk Treatment
nodes.title: Low-Risk CBF AML: ADE Plus Gemtuzumab Then HD-Cytarabine x 3
nodes.description: ADE induction with gemtuzumab ozogamicin followed by 3 cycles of high-dose cytarabine consolidation for low-risk core-binding factor AML; no allogeneic HCT in CR1 with chemotherapy survival above 75-80%.
nodes.path: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia / Low-Risk / Treatment
bullets: Induction ADE: Cytarabine 100 mg/m2/day continuous infusion days 1-10 plus Daunorubicin 50 mg/m2/day days 1, 3, 5 plus Etoposide 100 mg/m2/day days 1-5, with Gemtuzumab Ozogamicin (GO) 3 mg/m2 on day 6.
Consolidation: 3 cycles of High-Dose Cytarabine (HD-AraC 3 g/m2 every 12 hours days 1, 3, 5) with or without GO per protocol, with age-based intrathecal cytarabine per CNS status.
No allogeneic HCT in CR1 for low-risk CBF AML in first remission: chemotherapy overall survival above 75-80%; reserve HCT for persistent MRD, molecular relapse, or frank relapse.

Supportive care: TLS prophylaxis, anthracycline cardiac surveillance with serial echocardiograms, GO-associated sinusoidal obstruction syndrome and hepatotoxicity monitoring, and infection prophylaxis during neutropenia.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: ADE + Gemtuzumab Ozogamicin (GO) -> HD-Cytarabine Consolidation x 3 cycles

nodes.name: Intermediate-Risk Treatment
nodes.title: Intermediate-Risk AML: ADE Plus GO With MRD-Guided Consolidation vs HCT
nodes.description: ADE plus gemtuzumab induction with post-induction flow MRD triage: MRD negative below 0.1% after 2 cycles proceeds to HD-cytarabine consolidation with or without matched sibling HCT; persistent MRD allocates to allogeneic HCT from the best available donor.
nodes.path: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia / Intermediate-Risk / Treatment
bullets: Induction ADE (or 7+3 backbone) plus Gemtuzumab Ozogamicin: Cytarabine plus Daunorubicin plus Etoposide with GO 3 mg/m2, with age-based intrathecal cytarabine per CNS status.
Post-induction response assessment with flow-cytometric MRD after 2 induction cycles using the 0.1% threshold.
If MRD negative (below 0.1%) after 2 induction cycles: proceed to HD-Cytarabine consolidation with or without Matched Sibling Donor HCT based on genetics, donor availability, and family preference.
If persistent MRD positive (0.1% or higher): allocate to Allogeneic HCT from the best available donor (matched sibling, matched unrelated donor, cord blood, or haploidentical family donor).
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: ADE + GO -> Flow MRD-Guided Consolidation vs Matched Sibling HCT

nodes.name: High-Risk Treatment
nodes.title: High-Risk AML: Intensive Induction Plus FLT3 TKI Then Mandatory HCT in CR1
nodes.description: Intensive multi-agent induction with FLT3 TKI integration for FLT3-mutated disease, followed by mandatory allogeneic HCT in first complete remission from the best available donor.
nodes.path: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia / High-Risk / Treatment
bullets: Intensive multi-agent induction: ADE or CLAG-M (cladribine plus high-dose cytarabine plus mitoxantrone with G-CSF) selected by fitness, prior exposure, and institutional protocol, with CNS-directed intrathecal therapy.
TKI integration for FLT3-mutated AML: Sorafenib 200 mg/m2/day or Midostaurin per protocol starting during induction and continuing through consolidation and post-HCT maintenance where tolerated.

Mandatory Allogeneic HCT in first complete remission (CR1) from matched sibling, matched unrelated donor (MUD), umbilical cord blood, or haploidentical family donor; do not delay donor search given early HLA typing at workup.
High-risk cytogenetics (monosomy 7, del(5q), inv(3), t(6;9)) and induction failure proceed to HCT even with MRD negativity; enroll in a clinical trial wherever available.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: Intensive Induction +/- FLT3 TKI -> Mandatory Allogeneic HCT in CR1

nodes.name: Relapsed or Refractory Treatment
nodes.title: Relapsed or Refractory AML: FLAG-Ida or CPX-351 or Targeted Salvage to HCT
nodes.description: Re-induction salvage with FLAG-Ida or CPX-351, or targeted salvage with gilteritinib for FLT3-mutated relapse and revumenib for KMT2A-rearranged or NPM1-mutant relapse, bridging second remission to allogeneic HCT or CAR T-cell trials.
nodes.path: Pediatric Acute Myeloid Leukemia / Relapsed or Refractory / Treatment
bullets: Re-induction salvage regimens: FLAG-Ida (Fludarabine plus High-Dose Cytarabine plus Idarubicin plus G-CSF) or CPX-351 (daunorubicin and cytarabine liposome) selected by prior anthracycline exposure, fitness, and remission duration.
Targeted salvage: Gilteritinib for FLT3-mutated relapse; Revumenib (menin inhibitor) for KMT2A-rearranged or NPM1-mutant relapse, with QTc, differentiation syndrome, and cytopenia monitoring.
Restage marrow with flow MRD plus repeat cytogenetics and NGS at relapse, and restage CNS with lumbar puncture; give CNS-directed intrathecal therapy for CNS-positive disease.
Bridge second remission to second Allogeneic HCT or CAR T-cell clinical trials; enroll in a clinical trial wherever available.
Physician decides; dose engine calculates patient-specific doses.
nodes.regimenSummary: FLAG-Ida / CPX-351 or Targeted Salvage (Gilteritinib / Revumenib) -> Bridge to HCT
